<br><br>


::: {#hero-heading}

Bioinformatics scientist and quantitative researcher with 25+ years working at the intersection of machine learning, genomics, and collaborative science. Current work applies Bayesian models, bioinformatics methods, machine learning methods, using workflow management systems and AI tools to problems in epigenomics, variant pathogenicity and infectious disease — always in partnership with biologists, clinicians, and data scientists.
[Learn more about me &rarr;](/about){.about-links .subtitle}

:::
